MAIN PROMPT (attempt 1, NOT RUN)
Photograph at night, a bonfire at a pasture party in the late 1990s. In the middle third of the frame, a single young woman about twenty, long brown hair, denim jacket over a white tee, turns away across the fire, her face in profile with her hair falling across the far cheek, orange firelight on her jaw and shoulder. Sparks rise from the fire in the foreground, smoke drifting. Far behind her, soft and blurred, tall male silhouettes stand by two old dark pickup trucks. Warm orange firelight, black night sky, heavy fine film grain, shallow depth of field, 35mm, widescreen.

text, letters, license plate, logo, second woman, two women, group of girls, twins, other female figures, children, teenagers, baby, smartphones, modern clothing, bottle, beer, face toward camera, extra fingers, deformed hands, extra limbs, cartoon, illustration, 3D render look, lens flare, plastic skin, bright daylight, cool blue light
